headline: Over 300 million euros for investments. SOS adopted Sofia's budget for this year
summary: Sofia's municipal council adopted the city budget for this year, with more than 300 million euros earmarked for investments. Mayor Vasil Terziev forecast a significant transport deficit for 2026.
why: Municipal budgets set the scale of public investment and spending in Bulgaria's capital, affecting contractors and local transport finances.
